description: MyBatis-Plus generic CRUD: which Java types are mappers and services, and which entity and mapper each one carries.

rules.description: A type whose own extends or implements clause names BaseMapper is a MyBatis-Plus mapper, and BaseMapper's first type argument is its entity. A mapper that reaches BaseMapper through an interface of the project's own is found from here by the MyBatis-Plus bridge, which follows each clause down to a type that plays a role and binds the type arguments on the way.

examples.why: this rule names only the root of the chain; OrderMapper is found by the bridge, which binds T to Order

examples.source:
package com.example.repo;
public interface UserDao extends Repository<User, Long> {}
examples.why: another framework's base type is not a MyBatis-Plus mapper

examples.source:
package com.example.service;
public class UserFinder { private BaseMapper<User> mapper; }
examples.why: a field of type BaseMapper makes nothing a mapper; only a supertype does
tk.mybatis has a BaseMapper too, and the import says this is that one

examples.source:
package com.example.mapper;
public interface UserMapper extends com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.mapper.BaseMapper<User> {}
examples.why: written in full in the source: nothing in the file says it is another type

rules.description: A type whose own extends or implements clause names IService is a MyBatis-Plus service interface, and IService's first type argument is its entity.

examples.source:
package com.example.service;
public interface UserService { User find(Long id); }

rules.description: A class that extends ServiceImpl is a MyBatis-Plus service implementation: ServiceImpl's first type argument is its mapper and the second its entity. A class that binds only some of them, such as an abstract base, records what it binds.

examples.source:
package com.example.base;
public abstract class BaseServiceImpl<M extends BaseMapper<T>, T> extends ServiceImpl<M, T> {}
examples.why: an abstract base binds its own type parameters; a subclass binds them to real types

examples.source:
package com.example.service.impl;
public class UserServiceImpl implements UserService {}
